verdict.rationale: PayPal's checkout accepts PayPal, Venmo, Pay Later (BNPL, e.g. Pay in 4), and debit and credit cards from one offering, and Expanded Checkout adds card fields. Apple Pay and Google Pay are only evidenced for in-person tap-to-pay in the PayPal app, and Google Pay appears through Braintree for agentic commerce, not as part of the same web checkout integration. Missing for 10: online Apple Pay/Google Pay in the same checkout integration, bank redirect/local payment methods, explicit docs showing all methods enabled from a single integration, independent corroboration.
